methodFindings.Vehicle.TransferFromComponents: Reads ClassInformation on VehicleComponent.CurrentState; ordinary Class assignment requires one candidate bit; overrideIdentification or weapon paths read Object.getObjectIniName(); DetectedSide with a side entity lacking TaskforceReference falls back to Object._taskforce.
methodFindings.VehicleClassificationUpdate.OriginalLamb: Combines/intersects ClassInformation from current/last state and track entities, then writes candidates to CurrentState; can add DetectedSide under nationality-analysis conditions.
methodFindings.VehicleSideUpdate.OriginalLambdaBody: Carries DetectedSide from prior/current track evidence into CurrentState; self-track branch reads TaskforceMember for the controlled object's own taskforce.
methodFindings.VehicleSourcesUpdate.OriginalLambdaBody: Aggregates sensor modalities from track records still within each TrackComponent.MaxAge, computes strongest sonar/ESM values, and writes DetectingSensors to CurrentState.
methodFindings.Vehicle.IncomingSignalInfo: Uses the _bestTrack IncomingSignalData and caches text for the same track; it does not check HasLiveTrack; non-sonar/non-ESM formatting reads Object._sensorData._size.
methodFindings.Vehicle.get_IsDetectedTrackFresh: Compares missionSessionTime with the cached detected track epoch and that TrackComponent.MaxAge.
methodFindings.Vehicle.get_HasLiveTrack: Requires DetectedPosition and a fresh detected track, except for a self-track; it does not test destruction.
methodFindings.MapUnitViewModel.GetMapType: Maps ObjectBase._type and related implementation fields into VisualType, including Submarine and native sonobuoy deployment forms.
methodFindings.MapUnitViewModel.UpdateContactDisplay: When the class-info layer is visible, uses BaseObject class/display names if Identified; otherwise calls IncomingSignalInfo().
methodFindings.MapContactVisuals.Resolve: Uses CurrentRelationship for posture and relation color, then overrides with TM_DestroyedColor_Brush when BaseObject.IsDestroyed or TM_DormantColor_Brush when the contact is dormant.
methodFindings.VehicleAgeOut.OriginalLambdaBody: Deletes contacts for missing SPObjectRef, missing position state, or family-specific position-fix expiry; adds DormantVehicle at a shorter fix-age threshold; does not check ObjectBase.IsDestroyed.
